description: Full-text search across every past conversation. Returns ranked matches with highlighted snippets. Supports platform, title, date_from/date_to filters and a match_mode (any / all / phrase).

date_from.description: Only conversations updated on or after this date (ISO 8601)

date_to.description: Only conversations updated on or before this date (ISO 8601)

match_mode.description: How query terms combine: any, all, or phrase

platform.description: Restrict to one platform, e.g. claude or chatgpt

title.description: Restrict to conversations whose title contains this text

name: search_conversations
